summary: Tested Partner Mobile 'My Invoices' (Expo web, 420x860). Backend: 16/16 pytest tests pass covering /api/invoices list (pagination, range, sort, search, filter type/status/amount), detail (booking + withdrawal), HTML view, and PDF endpoints; unauthorized correctly returns 401. Frontend: page loads with correct data (9 invoices, ₹16,523.64 total, ₹11,917.64 paid for Raj Kumar), all KPIs, date chips, search + empty state + clear-all, sort sheet (all 10 options; amount_high correctly puts INV-2026-000009 ₹4,116 first), filter drawer (all filter-type-*, filter-status-*, filter-range-*, amount/customer/booking inputs, apply/reset), and detail panel for INV-2026-000001 (header, total, commissionable, net, share, more, download, back — plus Subtotal, Commission Rate, Partner Earning sections and PII masking). Row menu / Viewer / Share sheet / Deep link tests were repeatedly hijacked by the app's live 'Job Request' push after login (documented in the task) but backend equivalents of those flows are green.

integration_issues.flow: Detail/Viewer/Row-menu on invoices below the fold
integration_issues.issue: After opening & closing detail for the first card, subsequent clicks on invoice-card-view-INV-2026-000002 (and invoice-more-INV-2026-000002) frequently trigger the app's live Job-Request push and swap the visible screen to /partner/job-request or /partner/active-job, so the drawer never opens. Recommendation: while a partner has ongoing pushes, either suppress the auto-navigation while a modal/route is on invoices, or persist scroll+state and reopen the drawer after route restore.

issues: Section headings render in uppercase ('PAYMENT SUMMARY','CUSTOMER DETAILS','BOOKING DETAILS','YOUR EARNING','TIMELINE'). Web-panel reference uses Title-Case ('Payment Summary'). Consider aligning casing to keep 1:1 parity as required by the task.

action_items: Prevent the live Job-Request/Active-Job auto-route from overriding the invoices route while the invoice detail/viewer is open (or after user has interacted). This blocks the mobile 1:1 parity for detail/viewer/row-menu on any card below the initial viewport.
Align section-header casing on the mobile Detail panel to match web panel (title-case).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend /api/invoices/{invoice_number} 404s — detail endpoint accepts UUID id only. Consider also accepting invoice_number for developer ergonomics & deep-linking robustness.
Live push (job ring) navigation should be suppressed when the user is actively viewing an invoice screen/modal to avoid stealing focus (repro'd twice).

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (all list/search/sort/filter/detail-open flows verified; viewer/row-menu/deep-link blocked intermittently by job push)

seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seeded 9 partner invoices.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The Expo-web login sequence: onboard-skip -> skip-notifications-button -> fill [data-testid=login-phone-input] 9000000003 -> click 'Log In with OTP' -> single OTP input (not 6 boxes) -> fill 123456 -> click 'Verify & Log In'. Role picker may not appear. After landing, navigate directly to /partner/invoices. IMPORTANT: after ~10s a live job push routes the app to /partner/active-job or /partner/job-request; re-navigate to /partner/invoices to return. To open detail for cards below the fold, scroll the card into view first; even then the job push may pre-empt the click — retry navigating to invoices immediately and try again. Backend detail endpoint expects the invoice `id` (UUID), not invoice_number.
